title: [LOGGED IN] Player stays logged in after a reload and a page change

steps.saw: Store page loaded at /store; cookie banner shown at bottom.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss". If a "Login successful" popup is shown, click "Ok".
steps.saw: Clicked Dismiss on the cookie banner; no Login successful popup.

steps.text: Does the header show the green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button, and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button in header, balances 0 and 40, no Login button.

steps.text: Reload the page and wait until it has finished loading.
steps.saw: Reloaded /store (navigated to the same address) and waited for load.

steps.text: Does the header still show the "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button and no "Login" button?
steps.saw: Header still shows green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button and balances; no Login button.

steps.text: Does the header still show the "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button and both balances?
steps.saw: Header on Home shows green "Player{TEST_USER_ID}" button and both balances (0 and 40).
